description:
U by Urbeo is proud to present U Charlestown development, a residential development located right beside Charlestown shopping centre. All homes in the development are "A" rated, meaning residents will enjoy comfort and warmth all year round. Ample storage is provided in all unit types, with generous walk-in storage units. The interiors have been tastefully designed by Ventura Living and are fitted with bespoke U furniture

This scheme has been created with U in mind offering a range of expertly designed and spacious apartments that cater for all the needs of today's lifestyles. 

U Charlestown is excellently positioned and is served by the 9, 17A, 40, 40B, 40D, 83, 140 and 220 stopping close to the development with a peak journey time of 38 minutes to O 'Connell Street. Charlestown is right beside the M50 Motorway, providing easy access into and out of Dublin City Centre and further afield.

Take your pick from well over a dozen primary schools. There are four main secondary schools: New Cross College (Catholic, mixed), St Michael's (Catholic, girls') Beneavin De La Salle (Catholic, boys') and Coláiste Eoin (multidenominational, mixed).

There is plenty at Charlestown to keep younger kids active. Erin's Isle GAA has a long list of former Dublin footballers (and a great clubhouse), while Unidare Rugby Club is nearby in Ballymun. 


***Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.***
